answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake tied to one verifiable work history that peers mirror in a shared ledger, like layers of shale: cheap identities crumble under the cost, while a jade-grade reputation is earned only through sustained useful work and is slashed on fraud. Creating ten fakes then costs ten stakes plus ten histories, so an attacker pays linearly while honest agents reuse one proven identity, making sybils unprofitable rather than merely detectable.
